serverModes.COMPATIBLE: Initial legacy sessions permitted. First enrollment snapshots exact existing active flow IDs; new flows for enrolled bindings require proof.
serverModes.PERSISTENT: Fresh persistent-key and current role-key proof required for each A/B/O context.
serverModes.TPM_ATTESTED: Trusted TPM 2.0 key certification AND ActivateCredential proof required. Missing roots, unsupported profiles, expiry or failed activation rejects; no software fallback.

nativeKeyStorage: Windows user CNG KSP, app/server namespace, RSA2048, export policy 0; no private-key export API in production.

tpmProfile.name: TPM2_RSA2048_SHA256_CERTIFY_ACTIVATE_V1
tpmProfile.evidence: TPM2_ReadPublic + TPM2_Certify via provider-owned TBS context and virtual handles
tpmProfile.certification: fresh 32-byte server nonce; restricted nonmigratable AK; nonmigratable application signing key; exact public key/name binding; TPMS_ATTEST magic/type/clock safety; RSASSA/SHA256 signature
tpmProfile.activation: MakeCredential RSA2048 OAEP-SHA256 with IDENTITY NUL label; KDFa SHA256, AES128 CFB, HMAC-SHA256; PCP_TPM12_IDACTIVATION property; fresh random 32-byte secret signed by persistent and current A/B/O keys
tpmProfile.supportedKeyAuth: PCP_PASSWORD_REQUIRED is a BYTE; only empty authorization profile supported; password-required keys reject

trustConfiguration.requires: current administrator authorization, CSRF, recent reauthentication, expectedRevision and requestId

fields.roots: 1..32 explicitly trusted manufacturer CA PEM strings
fields.intermediates: 0..64 CA PEM strings required for the chosen leaf path
fields.validUntil: UTC milliseconds; operator-managed bounded freshness deadline

trustConfiguration.behavior: No system-root fallback, automatic root download, test root, or trust-on-first-use. Unknown critical extensions, incompatible purposes, revoked/expired paths fail closed. Intermediate/root expiry limits enrollment assurance.

migrationAndRecovery.enrollment: server-HMAC pseudonymous binding; same key may prove successive A/B/O roles; competing key commits rejected atomically
migrationAndRecovery.replacement: legacy device replacement retires old key, rotates approved new PC key namespace, closes old contexts; no license carryover
migrationAndRecovery.recovery: recent administrator action; optional 15-minute one-use grant; old key tombstones remain; revision/epoch fences; exact admin request replay returns stored result
migrationAndRecovery.clockBounds: wall expiry plus process-local monotonic bound; restart adopts only remaining wall lifetime and rejects before issuance; this does not attest host wall-clock correctness

workerBudget.output: public metadata and encrypted activation blob only; clear secret copies wiped on completion/error

validation.syntheticFixtureMeaning: cryptographic/parser/state tests only; not hardware evidence
validation.windowsTestRequirement: real Windows CNG persistent reopen/private-export denial; real TPM needs explicit trusted manufacturer input and hardware
